description: Metadata for abstractions in multi-threaded library manager.

library_manager-0.intent: Global path to initialize the book manager.
library_manager-0.name: global

library_manager-0-4.intent: Check if we are in main entry to program.

library_manager-1.intent: Accept the book and return the name and genre.
library_manager-1.name: Accept Book Information

library_manager-1-4.intent: Accepted a book with name <name> with genre <genre>.

library_manager-2-4-2.intent: Check if the user chose to add a book.

library_manager-2-4-2-2.intent: Add book named <name> with genre <genre> to basket.

library_manager-2-4-3.intent: Check if the user chose to place a book on the shelf.

library_manager-2-4-3-1.intent: Send task to add basket to shelf to bookshelf thread.

library_manager-2-4-3-2.intent: Clear the basket after sending it the bookshelf thread.

library_manager-2-4-4.intent: Check if the user chose to place a display the bookshelf and basket.

library_manager-2-4-4-1.intent: Send task to display basket and bookshelf to bookshelf thread.

library_manager-2-4-5-1.intent: Send task to tell bookshelf thread to terminate.

book_shelf_thread-0.intent: Global path for the bookshelf thread module.
book_shelf_thread-0.name: global

book_shelf_thread-0-3.intent: Define the BookShelfThread class that runs in its own thread.

book_shelf_thread-1.intent: Initialize the BookShelfThread with an empty bookshelf and a queue, then start the thread.
book_shelf_thread-1.name: Initialize BookShelfThread

book_shelf_thread-1-1.intent: Initialize the base Thread class with daemon mode disabled.

book_shelf_thread-1-2.intent: Create an empty bookshelf to store books grouped by first letter.

book_shelf_thread-1-3.intent: Store the incoming queue to receive tasks from the main thread

book_shelf_thread-1-4.intent: Start the thread so that the book shelf manager starts.

book_shelf_thread-2.intent: Log that the bookshelf thread is terminating when the object is destroyed.
book_shelf_thread-2.name: Terminate BookShelfThread

book_shelf_thread-2-1.intent: Print a termination message for the bookshelf thread.

book_shelf_thread-3.intent: Place all books from the basket onto the bookshelf grouped by the first letter of the book name.
book_shelf_thread-3.name: Place Books On Shelf From Basket

book_shelf_thread-3-1.intent: Iterate while there are still books in the basket.

book_shelf_thread-3-1-1.intent: Remove the next book from the basket.

book_shelf_thread-3-1-2.intent: Log that the book was accepted along with its name and genre.

book_shelf_thread-3-1-3.intent: Get the first letter of the book's name to determine the shelf slot.

book_shelf_thread-3-1-4.intent: Check whether a shelf slot already exists for this first letter.

book_shelf_thread-3-1-4-1.intent: Create a new shelf slot for this first letter.

book_shelf_thread-3-1-5.intent: Add the book's name to the appropriate shelf slot.

book_shelf_thread-4.intent: Process messages from the queue and update or display the bookshelf based on the message type.
book_shelf_thread-4.name: Run Book Shelf Thread Loop

book_shelf_thread-4-1.intent: Keep processing messages from the queue until told to quit.

book_shelf_thread-4-1-1.intent: Create block to safely check queue for messages.

book_shelf_thread-4-1-1-1.intent: Retrieve the next message from the queue with a timeout.

book_shelf_thread-4-1-2.intent: Catch exception raised when getting message from queue

book_shelf_thread-4-1-2-1.intent: There were no messages, so check for messages again.

book_shelf_thread-4-1-3.intent: Check if the message requests to add books from basket onto bookshelf.

book_shelf_thread-4-1-3-2.intent: Place books from the basket onto the shelf according to the message.

book_shelf_thread-4-1-4.intent: Check if the message requests the current bookshelf and basket to be displayed.

book_shelf_thread-4-1-4-1.intent: Print the current state of the bookshelf.

book_shelf_thread-4-1-4-2.intent: Print the current contents of the basket that was sent with the message.

book_shelf_thread-4-1-5.intent: Check if the message requests this thread to quit.

book_shelf_thread-4-1-5-1.intent: Break out of the loop and end the thread run method.
